ATTRIBUTE.Name: Observation ID
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A unique identifier of the Observation.
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: The uniqueness refers to the context of the dataset. Defined by the data submitter.

Value_Specification.Comment: CAVEAT: During dataset creation the submitter must use the Object Attribute “alias” to state a unique identifier, however, during the submission process that repository automatically generates a unique accession ID for each submitted CMMS Entity. This accession ID will be automatically injected into the XML file using the xs:attribute “accession” by the repository during the upload process. Once a accession ID has been generated all references to a given CMMS Entity must use the xs:attribute “accession” and not the xs:attribute “alias”.

DICOM_Specification.Change_Log: MSMdad v.0.1.2: introduced MSMdad v.1.0.0: none MSMdad v.2.0.0: none

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Observer Ref
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A reference to the Observer(s) of the Observation.

Value_Specification.Comment: CAVE: During dataset creation the xs:attribute “alias” must be used to reference a given CMMS Entity if the given CMMS Entity has not received an accession ID by the repository yet (I.e. Non-Complementary Datasets). However, during the submission process the repository will assign unique accession IDs to every CMMS Entity and internal references will be updated using the newly generated accession IDs by injecting them into the XML files. Once an accession ID has been assigned to a given CMMS Entity the xs:attribute “accession” must be used to reference the given CMMS Entity. This especially relates to Complementary Datasets, where only the xs:attribute “accession” must be used (also during data set creation) when an accession ID exists for a given CMMS Entity.

DICOM_Specification.Change_Log: MSMdad v.0.1.2: introduced MSMdad v.1.0.0: none MSMdad v.2.0.0: none

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Statement
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A pathological statement about a CMMS Entity regarded to be true for this CMMS Entity. This attribute is a set comprising the following attributes: ATTRIBUTE ID 15.3.1.1 Statement Type, ATTRIBUTE ID 15.3.1.2 Statement Status, ATTRIBUTE ID 15.3.1.3 Code Attributes Set, ATTRIBUTE ID 15.3.1.4 Custom Attributes Set, ATTRIBUTE ID 15.3.1.5 Freetext

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Statement Status
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A status indicating if the statement is necessarily true for all downstream entities (e.g. Images) to which the entity, about which the statement was stated, can be related to.
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: Summary: Integrating downstream information into the statement about the given entity, thereby the statement is not necessarily true for all downstream entities (e.g. Images) but only true for the entire collection/set of downstream or related entities. Distinct: The statement is true for the entity it is related to and all downstream entities.

DICOM_Specification.Change_Log: MSMdad v.0.1.2: introduced MSMdad v.1.0.0: none MSMdad v.2.0.0: none

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Code Attributes
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: These types of attributes refer to attributes that can be coded by the means of some internationally or at least published schema, classification, nomenclature or ontology. They comprise the same functionality as all `CodeAttributeTypes` in MetaFleX. As the complexity of a pathological statement can in many instances not be coded using only one ontology/classification/nomenclature (I.e. ICDO + TNM or multiple SEND/CDISC Variables) it was decided that one can add multiple CodeAttributes to a given Statement.

DICOM_Specification.Change_Log: MSMdad v.0.1.2: introduced MSMdad v.1.0.0: none MSMdad v.2.0.0: change of attribute name

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Custom Attributes
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A set of attributes defined freely by the submitter.
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: These types of attributes refer to information which can be stored by the means of a 'TAG' > 'VALUE' concept. All different MetaFleX Attributes can be used. As the complexity of a pathological statement can require a set of Custom Attributes (I.e. set of custom defined morphological descriptors) it was decided that multiple Custom Attributes can be assigned to a given statement.

DICOM_Specification.Change_Log: MSMdad v.0.1.2: introduced MSMdad v.1.0.0: none MSMdad v.2.0.0: change of attribute name

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Freetext
ATTRIBUTE.Description: This section of a statement comprises information that is only available as free text. It should be used to store original unparsed data, extracted from some source.
